title: Homework Ghostwriting
synopsis: With the increasing amount of homework Chinese school children have to do during the summer and winter vacation, some parents are turning to homework ghostwriting services.

fullText.simplified:
代写作业

    现在市场上出现了一种新的服务，叫“代写作业”。代写作业就是帮忙写作业。
    随着社会的发展，学生们的负担越来越重，每天都有写不完的作业。特别是暑假、寒假，每个科目几乎都有作业。比如，语文科目，有的老师会要求学生抄3遍课文，每天写一篇日记。因为作业太多，很多孩子表示放暑假、寒假根本没有玩的时间，比上学还累。
    在这样的环境下，代写作业的服务出现了。买家付钱给卖家后，卖家就会帮忙写作业，还会保证正确率。有的卖家甚至表示可以模仿买家的笔迹，不用担心被老师发现。一般来说，一本暑假作业80元，一篇作文10元。买家一般是小学生、初中生和高中生，卖家大多是大学生。
    现在的法律并没有明确禁止网络代写作业，所以从事这个服务的人越来越多。有的家长说，看到孩子每天从早到晚都在写作业，那么辛苦，不如花几十块钱在网上找代写，“应付”一下算了。更有家长表示，找人代写作业的行为很不好。但是暑假、寒假本来就应该让孩子放松休息的，现在却不得不每天写作业，老师应该减少作业量。
fullText.traditional:
代寫作業

    現在市場上出現了一種新的服務，叫“代寫作業”。代寫作業就是幫忙寫作業。
    隨著社會的發展，學生們的負擔越來越重，每天都有寫不完的作業。特別是暑假、寒假，每個科目幾乎都有作業。比如，語文科目，有的老師會要求學生抄3遍課文，每天寫一篇日記。因為作業太多，很多孩子表示放暑假、寒假根本沒有玩的時間，比上學還累。
    在這樣的環境下，代寫作業的服務出現了。買家付錢給賣家後，賣家就會幫忙寫作業，還會保證正確率。有的賣家甚至表示可以模仿買家的筆跡，不用擔心被老師發現。一般來說，一本暑假作業80元，一篇作文10元。買家一般是小學生、初中生和高中生，賣家大多是大學生。
    現在的法律並沒有明確禁止網絡代寫作業，所以從事這個服務的人越來越多。有的家長說，看到孩子每天從早到晚都在寫作業，那麼辛苦，不如花幾十塊錢在網上找代寫，“應付”一下算了。更有家長表示，找人代寫作業的行為很不好。但是暑假、寒假本來就應該讓孩子放鬆休息的，現在卻不得不每天寫作業，老師應該減少作業量。

raw.synopsis: With the increasing amount of homework Chinese school children have to do during the summer and winter vacation, some parents are turning to homework ghostwriting services.
sentence_translations: Now a new service has appeared on the market, called “homework ghostwriting”.
Homework ghostwriting means that you write someone's homework for them.
Following society's development the burden on students is getting heavier, and each day they have more homework than they can finish.
Especially during summer and winter vacation, almost every subject has homework.
For example, for literature and language subjects some teachers make students copy a text 3 times, and write diary every day.
Because there is too much homework, many children say that there is no time to play during summer and winter vacation, ..
.. and that it is more tiring than going to school.
It was under these circumstances that the homework ghostwriting service appeared.
After the buyer pays the seller, the seller will help out with the homework, and will also guarantee a rate of correctness.
Some sellers even say they can mimic the buyer's handwriting, so you need not worry about the teacher noticing.
Generally a summer vacation homework costs 80 yuan, and an essay costs 10 yuan.
The buyers are usually primary, junior, or senior high school students, and most sellers are university students.
At the moment there is no law that explicitly forbids homework ghostwriting, so more and more people sell this type of service.
Some family heads say that instead of watching their child painstakingly do homework from morning until late at night, ..
.. they rather spend a couple dozen yuan on finding a ghostwriter online and get it over with.
Other family heads say that the act of finding ghostwriters to do homework is bad.
But summer and winter vacation are originally made for children to relax, ..
.. but nowadays they instead have to do homework every day, so the teachers need to reduce the amount of homework.
